<td class="text"><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">21.     Subsequent Event</span></div><div><span><br/></span></div><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:112%">Deutsche Bahn Contract</span></div><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">As noted previously, in October 2026, the Company executed an agreement with Deutsche Bahn to end the ETO contract for the track utility vehicles. As a result, the Company returned approximately $73 million of advance payments previously received, which had been accrued, and was released from all obligations under this contract, including the related performance bonds. In addition, restricted cash of $48.9 million that was used to support contingent commercial commitments related to this contract will no longer be restricted.  </span></div><div><span><br/></span></div><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Clean Earth Sale Post-Closing Adjustment</span></div><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">In October 2026, the Company agreed to the final closing statement for the sale of CE to Veolia and received additional proceeds of $4.9 million.</span></div><span></span>

<tr><td><div class="body" style="padding: 2px;">
<a href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.toggleNext( this );">- Definition</a><div><p>The entire disclosure for significant events or transactions that occurred after the balance sheet date through the date the financial statements were issued or the date the financial statements were available to be issued. Examples include: the sale of a capital stock issue, purchase of a business, settlement of litigation, catastrophic loss, significant foreign exchange rate changes, loans to insiders or affiliates, and transactions not in the ordinary course of business.</p></div>
